name: JavaScript Number Guess
description:
Web-ready number guessing in JavaScript.

   $ node game.js
   Guess a number (1-100):
   > 50
   Too high!
   > 25
   Too low!
   > 37
   You Won! 🎉

Learn: Node.js, prompt-sync, conditionals.

fields.label: Your name
fields.help: Shown in the welcome and victory messages.

fields.label: Difficulty
fields.help: Easy: 1-50 with 10 guesses. Normal: 1-100 with 7 guesses. Hard: 1-200 with 5 guesses.
